title: Wave speed magnitude
description: Essential: The response must state the correct wave speed of 100 m/s.

title: Propagation direction
description: Essential: The response must correctly identify the wave's propagation direction as to the right.

title: Time to equilibrium
description: Essential: The response must give the correct time for particle P to first pass equilibrium downward as 0.05 s.

title: Average velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The response must give the correct magnitude of P's average velocity as (2√2)/5 m/s.

title: Wavelength identification
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify the wavelength from the figure as 8 m.

title: Applying frequency constraint
description: Important: The solution must apply the condition f < 30 Hz to select the correct wave speed from possible solutions.

title: Particle motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly analyze the phase of particle P to determine its initial displacement and subsequent motion to equilibrium.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Penalize incorrect sign for propagation direction or omission of units in final answers.

title: Wave equation confusion
description: Pitfall: Penalize confusing particle velocity with wave speed, or misapplying the relationship v = fλ.
